conceptual_change: Implement the specific volatility filter by requiring the current 14-period ATR to exceed the product of 1.05 and the 20-period moving average of the ATR as a hard gate for entry signal execution.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: Previous rejection was due to the lack of explicit engine implementation of the filter logic; this hypothesis proposes the technical integration of the identified volatility gate to verify if it reduces noise-induced entries.
